details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 4, Ranged

The Silver Tower sent you to Veradyna to catalogue the old magic of the frontier, and the Keepers were the only escort going north. A dark-skinned woman with a crown of black curls, you keep your white and gold Tower robes spotless and your long staff to hand, whatever the weather. You find the cold, the food and the company equally trying. You are very good, and you know it.

Tonight: Somewhere in this fort there is magic you can feel but not see.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Spellcasting. Intelligence. Spell save DC 14, 15 for Conjuration (School Focus). Slots: 4 cantrips, four 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells from your spellbook each morning. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield. See the spell page.

Arcane Recovery. Once a day, after 10 minutes of study, regain spent slots totalling up to 2 spell levels.

Flexible Preparation. When you prepare spells, leave one place open for each spell level; fill it with any spell of that level from your spellbook when you cast it.

Potent Cantrips. A creature that saves against your damaging cantrip (Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost) still takes half damage.

School Focus: Conjuration. +1 to the save DC of your Conjuration spells (Grease, Web, Glitterdust).

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Steady Focus (feat, 1st). Advantage on saves to keep a spell you are casting, or concentration, when damaged, shoved or forced to react. And you can't lose a spell to damage of 5 or less.

Kit: Silver Tower Scholar. Elemental Precision: reroll any 1s on the damage dice of your spells that deal elemental damage (once per die). Aldorethi Theory: Advantage recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.

Human. Advantage on Perception checks (chosen skill). Elvish, the tongue most arcane texts are still written in, is your chosen language. Weapon training: light crossbow and shortsword. Light and medium armour training, though you still can't cast in armour.

Casting

Also in your spellbook: Sleep, Grease, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages (1st).

Armour Class on the sheet: Dex +2. 15 with Mage Armour (8 hours)

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells per the Spells Per Day table, plus Bonus Spells from high Intelligence.

Flexible Preparation

  • Effect: When you prepare spells, you may leave one place on your list open for each spell level. Fill it with any spell of that level from your spellbook when you cast it. Always on.

School Focus

  • Effect: Choose one school of magic (see Spellcasting in Arneyan). The save DC of your spells of that school is increased by 1.

2nd Level

Arcane Recovery

  • Effect: Once per day, after 10 minutes of study, regain expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up). None may be above 5th level.

3rd Level

Potent Cantrips

  • Effect: A creature that saves against your damaging cantrip still takes half damage. Always on.

4th Level

Detect Magic

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study, an Intelligence check reveals the magical origin of an item whose kind of magic you have met before.
  • From 18th level it also reveals the item's power and history

5th Level

Arcane Ward

  • Effect: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you gain temporary HP equal to twice its level until the encounter ends. Keep the higher amount; it doesn't stack. Always on.

6th Level

Cantrip Expertise

  • Effect: Add your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) to the damage of your damaging cantrips. Does not stack with the Cantrip Mastery feat.

8th Level

Arcane Ward improves

  • Effect: From 8th level, the temporary HP equal three times the spell's level.

9th Level

Arcane Resilience

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. Always on.

10th Level

Second School

  • Effect: Choose a second school for School Focus. The save DC of your spells of that school is also increased by 1.

13th Level

Spell Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one 1st-level spell in your spellbook that has no costed material component.
  • It can't be a spell that imposes a condition.
  • You can cast it at its lowest level without expending a spell slot, as often as you like.
  • You can change your choice during downtime, after a day of study.

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

18th Level

Sculpt Spells

  • Effect: When you cast an area spell, you may leave out a number of creatures you can see equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); they are unaffected. This applies to every area spell you cast.

Kits: Arneyan Arcane Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Wizard folder. Drag one onto your character.

Wizard Kits represent the institution, tradition, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts.

Wizard Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the wizard is high enough level to cast that spell tier at all.

(Constitution) Gain +1 Max HP per level (retroactive). Gain +1 to Constitution (once, on taking this feat). Advantage on Constitution-based checks.

Open to all classes by default.

A blow lands, the ground shifts, someone grabs at you mid-casting — and the working holds anyway. You have Advantage on saves made to keep a spell you are casting, or to maintain concentration on one, when you take damage, are shoved or are otherwise forced to react mid-cast, and you can't lose a spell to damage of 5 or less.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
